briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate frontier race with multi-agent breakthroughs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate multi-agent systems while regulatory scrutiny intensifies globally. Compute buildouts continue at unprecedented scale with new hyperscale clusters coming online. Prompt injection vulnerabilities persist across production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with advanced reasoning chains; Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus shows gains in long-context tasks; Google DeepMind's Gemini 3 and Meta's Llama 4 enter testing; DeepSeek R2 challenges Western dominance.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT environments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: xAI expands Memphis Colossus to 1M GPUs; Microsoft and Oracle announce joint 200k H100 cluster; TSMC reports sustained demand for next-gen AI accelerators.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will open-source models close the capability gap with closed frontier systems before 2027?
